verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Claude Design can generate images/design directions from prompts (community tested 'bear on a bicycle', though called underwhelming) and offers layout/adjustment tools for spacing and color, but there is no documentation or hands-on evidence of dedicated background removal, content-aware fill, or copy-suggestion tools inside the editor. missing for 10: background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions, and independent confirmation of reliable in-editor image generation.
